sourav: Heads up — noticed the route-level ratecap numbers in Console aren't matching SDK telemetry for a handful of tenants. Console shows steady 120 rps but our SDK events show spikes and drops. Anyone else seeing this?

alex: oof. which route? can you paste the route header and a sample event?

sourav: route: `x-routename: inbound-search-v2`
sourav: sample SDK event (redacted): `{"ts":1719953198,"route":"inbound-search-v2","rps":35,"window_ms":1000}`

karin: console tile is aggregating per-minute buckets and applying a smoothing window in the UI. SDK telemetry is per-second, so they'd look different. but 120 vs spikes still sounds off.

will: also check if the console is showing deduped requests (we dedupe identical client retries) while SDK reports raw attempts. could explain higher console number sometimes.

alex: @sourav can you check the SDK event tag `client_retry=true`? if there are retries being suppressed by the proxy, console would show final accepted count.

sourav: grabbing full event stream now. quick grep shows ~20% events have `retry:true`. here's a short snippet: ```
1719953198 inbound-search-v2 rps=35 retry=true status=504
1719953201 inbound-search-v2 rps=0 retry=false status=200
1719953202 inbound-search-v2 rps=40 retry=true status=502
```

karin: that pattern suggests transient backpressure — SDK emits retry attempts, proxy eventually accepts one, console dedupes to the accepted requests. But why would console be 120 steady, not matching accepted count? maybe our console aggregation is pulling from the infra meter (post-proxy) while the console's route tile uses a cached pre-aggregated snapshot that didn't refresh.

will: @ops-bot can you confirm refresh cadence for route tiles and whether we have any stuck snapshot jobs? :eyes:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: snapshot-job for analytics/route-tiles completed at 1719952800, next run scheduled 1719956400. No immediate errors reported.

alex: ah — the tile uses snapshot ingestion that runs every 10m, while infra meter is streaming. if someone is looking at Console during a surge, the tile will show the last snapshot (which may be artificially 'steady') until the next run. that's a UX mismatch we should call out.

karin: agree. proposal: update tile tooltip to indicate 'last snapshot at T' and add a small live-sync indicator when telemetry differs by >20%. also file an eng task to make snapshot cadence configurable per-dashboard.

sourav: sounds good. opened ticket RD-8732 with logs and example tenant. tagging @alex @karin. thanks for the triage. :thumbsup:

alex: quick workaround for affected customers — point them to the infra-meter streaming dashboard until fixed. i'll add a note in the tenant incident doc.

will: note for SDK team — we should add `dedup_annotation` to telemetry so downstream consumers can choose to show deduped vs raw attempts. I'll draft a tiny PR.

karin: cool. closing loop: sourav, ping here when RD-8732 has updates and i'll own the Console tooltip change.

sourav: will do, thx all.
